summary.result: The results of this study can be used as a basis for the national and local governments to establish reasonable heat wave damage reduction measures and can also contribute to the development of future institutionalization plans and heat wave damage prediction models.
summary.background: It is necessary to discover variables that can increase the explanatory power of the model in the future, but management by local governments is necessary for variables that represent the current explanatory power.
summary.method: As a result of applying the regression model, the significance of personal factors, environmental factors, and social factors was shown, and the explanatory power of the model was only 40.1%.
